authority.qualification: Measured from the current live site at scrollY 0 after its hero settled. The recording uses the same 1508x761 CSS viewport at DPR 2; this live DOM probe used DPR 1 because CSS-pixel geometry is unchanged.

acceptance.policy: Every authoritative x, y, width, and height component must be within the tolerance. Missing implementation elements fail. This DOM gate is independent of raster and WebGL structural gates and cannot make either one pass.
acceptance.applicabilityQualification: Only the two zero-progress settled landing states share the exact measured live scroll and layout state. No later journey state inherits these bounds.

identityRasterMask.provenance: The recording is a flattened 3016x1522 RGB raster and provides no pixel-precise source glyph/logo alpha or mask layer.
identityRasterMask.decision: Do not mask a DOM rectangle or color/edge-segmented approximation because either can remove container, background, scene, or antialiasing pixels. Raster comparison remains fully unmasked.
